verses.text: Give ear to my words, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.

segments.text: Give ear to my words, O Jehovah,
Consider my meditation.

verses.text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.

segments.text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God;
For unto thee do I pray.

verses.text: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto thee, and will keep watch.

segments.text: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice;
In the morning will I order
my prayer
unto thee, and will keep watch.

verses.text: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.

segments.text: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness:
Evil shall not sojourn with thee.

verses.text: The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

segments.text: The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight:
Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

verses.text: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.

segments.text: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies:
Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.

verses.text: But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house: In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

segments.text: But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house:
In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

verses.text: Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.

segments.text: Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies;
Make thy way straight before my face.

verses.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.

segments.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth;
Their inward part is very wickedness;
Their throat is an open sepulchre;
They flatter with their tongue.

verses.text: Hold them guilty, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.

segments.text: Hold them guilty, O God;
Let them fall by their own counsels;
Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions;
For they have rebelled against thee.

verses.text: But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice, Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

segments.text: But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice,
Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them:
Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

verses.text: For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield.

segments.text: For thou wilt bless the righteous;
O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; with the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.
